why: Adding a ‘keep together’ binding caused the model to stop cutting between prepositions/opening parens/numerals and their complements, which reduced contradiction and raised H_set mainly for short pieces (bins ≤3 and ≤5) but also shifted many boundaries (merging phrases like “elsewhere in the UK”) and so lowered cohesion or created worse splits for a substantial minority.
lesson: A later revision should preserve the preposition/parenthesis/numeral binding because it improves short-bin H_set, but avoid a blanket enforcement that shifts many boundaries and thereby hurts cohesion elsewhere.
